_comment: Configuration for screenshot-watcher.ps1. Copy this file to screenshot-watcher.config.json and fill in your values.
_UploadSecret_comment: Set to the same value as UPLOAD_SECRET on the server. Leave empty to disable auth (single-host / private LAN only).
_Filter_comment: Comma-separated glob patterns for files to watch. Defaults to *.png,*.jpg,*.jpeg.
